steps.what: Assess the patient and review relevant clinical information
Provide nursing care and evaluate the patient's response
Write the clinical encounter note from actual assessment and care facts

loop.purpose: Turn clinician-entered encounter facts into concise nursing-note wording
loop.input: clinician-entered assessment, care and response facts captured within this step
loop.check: Instructor verifies patient identity, every finding, negation, timing, treatment attribution and omissions against actual encounter; no inferred diagnosis or action
loop.stop: Missing source facts or two failed drafts means manual note completion within retained time
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native structured fields first; variable narrative of patient response still requires wording and complete meaning review

steps.what: Check and complete the clinical note in the patient record

tasks.design: Test the native clinical-record category {OTHER} note template, then use a bounded wording loop only for narrative from the instructor's entered facts. Retain assessment, care, source capture and complete note checking; ordinary completion of the author's note stays ungated and fully counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative wording takes time, but a wrong note can mislead the next clinician.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-limited note drafting can reduce wording while retaining the clinician's full checks.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical judgement, patient response and correcting misleading omissions.
tasks.human_edge: Assess and care for the person rather than infer clinical facts from a template.
tasks.altitude: Some note wording is shorter; clinical scope and accountability do not change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting from clinician-entered facts can assist nursing-note wording, subject to full clinical verification; no local performance is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the instructor's own nursing encounter and original clinical note. Shares are provisional, not a measured clinical baseline; authorisation of medication or treatment is not automated.

The instructor produces assessment in s1 and actual care/response in s2. s3 includes the original structured fact entry and manual prose fallback; there is no free transcript, ambient recording or new source-data capture outside counted time. The loop uses only those entered facts.

{OTHER} is the clinical record. Test native fields and templates first. Only narrative rewording, 15% of s3, is removed; source entry, meaning review, repair and ordinary saving remain. s4 is completion/checking, not an artificial approval gate on an author's save.
If a separate discharge communication, prescription or order is part of actual practice, add its own real authorisation and release steps. No such clinical commitment is hidden in note completion.
unknowns: Actual source capture and repair time
research_questions: Can source-limited wording reduce note work without losing negation, timing or care attribution?

already_counted.description: Fact entry, draft repair and complete clinical verification remain in s3-s4.

incremental.description: Instructor checks draft behaviour and note template after clinical or model changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 25*0.15=3.75 wording hours removed less 1 upkeep gives 2.75 net. Cautious case: a complex encounter requires manual reconstruction, leaving only 1.1 hours of simple response wording removed and 0.1 net; patient care and source entry remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees

steps.what: Read committee papers and check relevant academic or departmental evidence
Discuss institutional policies and academic issues in committee
Write the instructor's assigned committee proposal or response
Check final contribution, evidence and committee recipients
outputs: final checked committee contribution and recipients

steps.what: Send the final checked contribution to the committee
inputs: final checked committee contribution and recipients

tasks.design: Reuse the committee's native {DOCS} contribution headings. The instructor reads original evidence, participates in deliberation and writes the actual assigned proposal; its separate send follows final-version and recipient checking.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee decisions depend on competing academic priorities and deliberation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native proposal layout removes limited repeated formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing policy consequences and representing departmental concerns fairly.
tasks.human_edge: Deliberate, negotiate and take responsibility for a position.
tasks.altitude: Unchanged committee voice and decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a fixed committee proposal layout can remove formatting, while evidence review and deliberation stay human.

assumptions: This branch includes an actual assigned contribution read by the committee, not a new minutes log. Attendance-only committee work has a different mix; verify provisional shares.

The committee secretary supplies agenda and original papers; the instructor checks evidence in s1 and creates the position and proposal in s2-s3. No free meeting transcript or automatic minutes are assumed.

Test native layout first. Only headings, 5% of s3, are removed; all substantive writing and ordinary saving remain. s4 checks the completed version and exact committee recipients before s5; edits void approval.
Sending a proposal does not activate institutional policy. Any formal vote, approval or policy publication belongs to its actual separate workflow.
unknowns: Actual contribution workload versus attendance-only meetings
research_questions: Does the committee already supply a layout that makes further configuration unnecessary?

already_counted.description: Evidence review, deliberation, writing and final checking remain.

incremental.description: Instructor checks proposal layout against changed committee requirements.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final contribution and exact committee recipient list; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 20*0.05=1 layout hour removed less 0.3 upkeep gives 0.7 net. Cautious case: a novel policy needs a custom paper structure, leaving 0.4 hours of standard heading reuse and 0.1 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain teaching materials and laboratory supplies

steps.what: Define textbook, material and laboratory equipment requirements
Compare editions, specifications, accessibility and supplier availability
Calculate quantities, pack totals and purchase costs
Enter the supply requisition with selected quantities and item details
Check final requisition, costs, delivery location and purchasing destination
outputs: final checked requisition and purchasing destination

steps.what: Submit the checked requisition to purchasing for actual order approval
inputs: final checked requisition and purchasing destination

steps.what: Check received materials against the requested teaching requirements

tasks.design: Configure native quantity/pack-cost calculations and catalogue-linked requisition fields in {PROCUREMENT}. The instructor chooses suitable materials, checks the finished requisition, submits it separately to purchasing and checks actual deliveries; purchasing retains its own budget approval and supplier ordering.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials suitability is a teaching decision, while repeated cost arithmetic and item typing are clerical.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue and calculation fields can reuse the selected supplier item.
tasks.still_hard: Correct editions, clinical realism, accessibility and substitutions.
tasks.human_edge: Choose resources that teach the intended safe practice.
tasks.altitude: Less arithmetic and repeated item entry; no additional spending authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: purchasing catalogue forms can reuse selected item details and calculate quantity costs while teachers retain suitability checks.

assumptions: Focal boundary is instructor selection, requisition and delivery check. Purchasing's later approval, supplier order and receipt accounting are separate existing workflows with no claimed saving here. Shares are provisional.

The instructor supplies learner counts and required quantities in s1; purchasing maintains supplier item, edition/model, pack size, price and currency, checked in s2. Missing or incomparable catalogue fields are manually repaired within s2/s4-s5. No free PDF extraction or new supplier feed.

Test native {PROCUREMENT} calculations and catalogue-linked fields first. s3 represents actual manual calculation today, not automatic runtime. s4 removes only repeated catalogue identity fields, 15%; quantities, delivery requirements and ordinary ungated save remain.

s5 checks the completed requisition and exact purchasing destination before s6; edits void approval. This approves submission of a request only, not the commercial purchase. An actual receipt record, if entered by this instructor, must be separately counted; s7 is physical delivery checking.
research_questions: Can native requisition fields remove repeated catalogue details without bypassing purchase approval?

already_counted.description: Selection, missing-field repair and final requisition checks remain.

incremental.description: Instructor checks calculation and catalogue mappings when teaching supply types change.

approvals.approved_version: s5 final requisition, item set, costs, delivery location and exact purchasing destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 15 calculation hours plus 15*0.15=2.25 re-entry hours removed less 1 upkeep gives 16.25 net. Cautious case: custom laboratory equipment has incomparable packs, leaving only 2.5 hours of standard-item arithmetic and 0.5 of identity reuse, or 2 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support student recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Check current programme, registration and clinical-placement requirements
Discuss the programme, registration needs and placement preferences with students
Enter the actual registration or placement-support record
Resolve placement constraints and check the final support referral and destination
outputs: final checked student-support referral and destination

steps.what: Send the checked support referral to the authorised student-services team
inputs: final checked student-support referral and destination

tasks.design: Use existing-student context in the student-registration and placement category {OTHER} to avoid retyping a known student identifier into the actual support referral. Keep recruitment guidance, entry of actual needs, placement constraints and final referral checks human; no admissions or placement decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student needs and clinical-placement suitability cannot be reduced to identity fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native student-context forms can reuse an existing identifier.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical-placement constraints, accessibility and distinguishing advice from an admission decision.
tasks.human_edge: Understand individual needs and guide students realistically.
tasks.altitude: Very small entry relief; unchanged recruitment and placement-support role.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: student-system context can reuse an existing identifier in support records without deciding admission or clinical placement.

assumptions: Boundary combines recruitment guidance with an actual registration/placement-support referral used by student services. Confirm this branch and its provisional shares; an information-only recruitment event needs a different mix.

Programme staff supply rules; student administration maintains student identifier and enrolment context; the instructor obtains actual needs in s2 and enters them in s3. New applicants without a record are entered manually in retained s3; no free structured intake is assumed.
Test native student-context forms first. Only repeated existing identifier entry, 4% of s3, is removed. All preferences, clinical constraints, corrections and ordinary ungated saving remain.

s4 checks the final referral and exact authorised team before s5; edits void approval. This is a support request, not admission, formal registration activation or placement allocation; those actual decisions and releases remain separate.
research_questions: Can existing-student context remove retyping without changing eligibility or placement decisions?

already_counted.description: Needs entry, new-applicant capture, placement constraint resolution and final checking remain.

incremental.description: Instructor checks student-context links and access after programme changes.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final student-support referral and exact authorised student-services destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 25*0.04=1 identifier hour removed less 0.3 upkeep gives 0.7 net. Cautious case: recruitment is mostly new applicants requiring original capture, leaving 0.4 hours of existing-student reuse and 0.1 net; guidance and placement checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Limited note wording and native form calculations reduce supporting work while clinical care, teaching governance and student decisions remain human.
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous clinical, admissions or placement authority is proposed.
